app.name: Wii DNS Switcher
app.short_description: Switch DNS on existing Wi-Fi connections
app.long_description: Saves named primary-DNS profiles on the SD card and applies them directly to the console's configured Wi-Fi connections, without touching SSIDs, passwords, or other settings. Secondary DNS is always set to 1.1.1.1. Port of the 3DS DNS Switcher, using the config.dat layout documented by the OfflineNetworkEnabler project.
